eyebrow: Python for Data Science · Chapter 1, Lesson 1
subtitle: Step 2 of the Data Scientist path — the tool that cleans, reshapes, and analyzes data at scale.

eyebrow: What you'll do in this lesson
Step 1 — install Python 3 and check it
code:
python --version
# Python 3.9.13  (any recent Python 3 is fine)

import sys
print(sys.version)
print(sys.executable)
caption: sys.executable prints the exact interpreter that's running — useful once you have more than one Python installed.

eyebrow: Step 2 — one virtual environment per project
code:
python -m venv .venv

# Windows (PowerShell)
.venv\Scripts\activate

# macOS / Linux
source .venv/bin/activate
caption: A venv is a private folder holding its own interpreter and packages — an upgrade in one project can't break another.

eyebrow: Step 3 — install packages and record them
code:
pip install numpy pandas matplotlib
pip freeze > requirements.txt

# requirements.txt now lists exact versions:
# numpy==1.23.1
# pandas==1.4.3
caption: Rebuild the same environment anywhere with: pip install -r requirements.txt
